Forged_Iron_Bear_Trap_Jaws.description: Forged from unyielding iron, the Forged_Iron_Bear_Trap_Jaws form a relentless maw that clamps down with crushing force, its mechanical jaws designed to immobilize prey with brute strength, while simultaneously reducing the agility of those ensnared.

Clockwork_Grinding_Gears_Maw.description: The Clockwork Grinding Gears Maw is a mechanical horror, a vast, serrated mouth anchored to the front of a towering construct's head, its gears grinding with relentless precision to tear through flesh and steel alike, leaving wounds that bleed profusely and parts that are easily sundered.

Gargoyle_Obsidian_Snapping_Muzzle.description: The Obsidian Snapping Muzzle is a fearsome construct, its stone jaw lined with jagged, razor-sharp teeth that can crush bones with ease, while its robust cephalon provides an innate resilience that deflects incoming attacks, enhancing the gargoyle's formidable presence on the battlefield.

Furnace_Grate_Incinerating_Maw.description: The Furnace Grate Incinerating Maw is a fearsome cephalon construct, its gaping maw constantly exhaling scorching heat and swirling steam, reducing nearby foes to ash while its aura of blazing fire intimidates and weakens the spirits of those who dare approach.

Crystal_Resonance_Sonic_Maw.description: Embedded within the crystalline structure of its formidable cephalon, the Crystal Resonance Sonic Maw vibrates with arcane energies, generating a sonic resonance that can shatter the will and defenses of its foes, its sharp crystalline teeth capable of slicing through matter with the power of pure sound.

Necrotic_Stitched_Horror_Jaws.description: The Necrotic Stitched Horror Jaws, a grotesque amalgamation of desiccated flesh and twisted metal, exude a malevolent aura as they tear through air with unnatural strength, spewing a noxious cloud of toxins and instilling an eerie dread in all who witness their unholy feeding.

Scrap_Metal_Scissor_Beak.description: The Scrap_Metal_Scissor_Beak is a fearsome cephalon component, forged from twisted scraps of metal and imbued with a predatory essence, its razor-sharp beak capable of slicing through flesh and bone with terrifying ease, while enhancing the agility and precision of its wielder.

Wooden_Nutcracker_Jaws.description: Enormous jaws crafted from gnarled, ancient wood clamp together with terrifying force, their inner surfaces lined with sharp, jagged teeth that mimic the resilience and strength of living plant matter, capable of crushing even the toughest of foes.

Porcelain_Painted_Doll_Maw.description: This entity's head is a grotesque masterpiece, crafted from fine porcelain and painted with hauntingly beautiful yet disturbing imagery, blending the innocence of a doll with the predatory nature of a maw, its gaze both captivating and chilling, ensnaring prey with an ethereal charm.

Skeletal_Undead_Bone_Maw.description: The Skeletal_Undead_Bone_Maw is a nightmarish cephalon, its skull elongated and twisted into a gaping maw filled with razor-sharp, jagged bone teeth, capable of delivering biting attacks that cause grievous wounds and leave enemies bleeding profusely.
